_comment: EXPERIMENT profile 'low-media' — overlays the default profile. Dampens the raw-article-count term (MediaReachWeight 0.10 -> 0.05) so AttentionScore is driven by tier-weighted DISTINCT-PUBLISHER breadth rather than sheer article volume. Hypothesis (from the post-91 re-measure): an all-aggregator name (HLIO) should drop to ~Att 30 while a genuinely-covered name holds higher. Selects a named scoring profile so the effective config gets its own fingerprint + data/scoring-configs artifact (fully traceable). Output is routed to data/experiments/low-media/ so the baseline data is untouched. TWO deltas are required, not one, EVER SINCE default.json BEGAN DECLARING Radar:Strategies EXPLICITLY (commit 168125b; spec 154 widened that list to eight entries) — that is the operator obligation, and it is why the Radar:Strategies block below exists. (1) Radar:Scoring:Profile names 'low-media' as the AMBIENT profile, as it always has. (2) Radar:Strategies:0:ScoringProfile ALSO points the PRIMARY strategy at it. Before default.json declared Radar:Strategies the second was unnecessary: Radar SYNTHESISED a single primary that inherited the ambient profile — the exact key (1) overlays — and the experiment's weights reached the score for free. Now that default.json declares Radar:Strategies explicitly (eight entries), each entry resolves its OWN ScoringProfile, so (1) alone would leave the primary on entry 0's 'default' — which names no profile under Radar:Scoring:Profiles and therefore falls through to the CODE DEFAULTS (MediaReachWeight 0.10). The run would still route to data/experiments/low-media/, still print 'run profile: low-media', still stamp a ScoringConfigVersion, and produce numbers that look like the experiment ran while being the baseline: a fail-open of the exact shape specs 138 and 149 each had to close. run-radar.ps1 merges the overlay ONE FLAT KEY AT A TIME (Radar:A:B:0:C), so the single-field entry below overrides Radar:Strategies:0:ScoringProfile and NOTHING else — the primary keeps its Name from default.json. The three 'baseline-' CONTROL strategies at indices 5-7 are DELIBERATELY NOT re-pointed (indices 1-4 are the composite arms — the notedness curve at 1-3, narrative-led-v2 at 4 — and they are not re-pointed either): a control has to be the SAME control in the baseline run and in the experiment, or the two runs are not comparable and AD-15 ('beat every baseline out-of-sample') means nothing. Only the variable under test moves. Both facts are asserted by DefaultRunProfileTests (LowMediaOverlay_ActuallyReachesThePrimaryStrategysWeights and LowMediaOverlay_ChangesOnlyThePrimarysProfile_LeavingTheControlsIdentical), which bind default.json + this file exactly as run-radar.ps1 does.
